anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI subsystem has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading performance metrics show no active or profitable trades, which could indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially retrain AI models to ensure they are generating opportunities and making adjustments as expected.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and consider adjustments or alternative strategies to improve trading outcomes.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Assess the AI subsystem to ensure it is functioning correctly and contributing to trading decisions.
